text:
sophie: Heads-up: ap-southeast1 is showing a spike of Pending GPU pods after a spot eviction wave. Lots of failures around GPU generation mismatch and topologySpread refusals.
leo: can you paste the error from the scheduler?
sophie: pasted one pod describe:
```
Name: resnet-train-7
Namespace: vision
Status: Pending
Reason: Unschedulable
Message: 0/110 nodes are available: 65 node(s) had incompatible GPU generations, 30 node(s) had topologySpreadConstraint conflicts; 15 node(s) had taints not tolerated
```
rahul: sounds like warmpool + spot reprovisioning created a mix: many new nodes are V100 while the warmpool was A10G-biased. topologySpread is pushing pods away from racks that have mixed shapes.
sre-oncall: infra-bot reports: [autoscaler] scaled up 3 -> 8 nodes in ap-southeast1 (reason: pending pods). Provisioning still in progress.
sophie: idea: two short-term fixes: (1) temporarily relax topologySpreadConstraint for the failing deployment to let scheduler co-locate across racks, (2) apply a preferred nodeAffinity to allow V100 placements for low-priority batch jobs.
leo: quick patch for (1): update the deployment with a reduced maxSkew=100 and weight lower so scheduler can place more flexibly. e.g.
```yaml
topologySpreadConstraints:
- maxSkew: 100
  topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
  whenUnsatisfiable: "ScheduleAnyway"
  labelSelector: { matchLabels: { app: resnet } }
```
rahul: caution: ScheduleAnyway bypasses the constraint entirely on pressure. fine for non-latency sensitive training but not for real-time infer. tag jobs with `workload=best-effort` before flipping.
sophie: will patch a canary for two replicas first. also considering a taint-lite label: `gpu.allow-hetero=true` on nodes that pass gpu-driver-check; scheduler will have a short skip for strict-gen match.
infra-bot: [healthcheck] node-probe failures: 4 nodes in ap-southeast1 returned GPU driver mismatch, holding taints.
leo: do not mass-remove taints; perform targeted taint removal on nodes that passed driver version check: `kubectl taint nodes -l gpu-driver=ok gpu-gen-avoid-`
rahul: filed GH #infra/placement-462: "fallback scheduling for GPU-gen heterogeneity + console skew chart". includes proposal to expose warmpool flavor histogram.
sophie: canary applied at 1799987700. pending pods down from ~320 -> ~48 in 3m. most remaining are topologySpread blocks.
sre-oncall: monitoring P95/P99 for training jobs while canary is active. alert if P99 latency increases >15%.
leo: action items: sophie 12 do canary + targeted taint lift; rahul 12 add skew metric and GH; infra 12 add driver-check to warmpool lifecycle.
sophie: I'll post a short customer note if we widen placement. keeping canary for 25m, auto-revert if perf regresses. :white_check_mark:
leo: adding Optimize suggestion: make warmpool flavor-alignment recommendations per workload tag to reduce future reprovision mismatch.
sophie: thanks all, will update when canary auto-reverts or we see anomalous latencies.
